title: The Body's Yes
subtitle: the trace before the verdict
mapEpigraph: Your body answers before you have the words.

prompts.text: Recall one past choice your body registered before your mind did.
What did the breath, shoulders, jaw, chest, or stomach do?
What changed in my body when I imagined each path?

blocks.title: Two possibilities, one at a time
blocks.instruction: Bring two real possibilities to mind, one at a time. Stay with each for thirty seconds. Record only the physical changes — no conclusion required.

blocks.closing: Notice one lean and one brace before evening.
